selector.rationale: Patient has positive lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin IgM, and anti-phosphatidylserine IgM, which are indicative of antiphospholipid syndrome, and also has a positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus

rejected.label: Infectious mononucleosis
rejected.why: Although Epstein-Barr virus DNA PCR is positive, the clinical presentation and other laboratory findings do not strongly support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Vasculitis
rejected.why: Biopsy results show thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy without significant neutrophils or leukocytoclasia, which is not typical for vasculitis

rejected.label: Thrombotic vasculopathy
rejected.why: While the biopsy results do show thrombotic vasculopathy, the presence of antiphospholipid antibodies suggests a more specific diagnosis of antiphospholipid syndrome
